description: Header file defining functions and types for handling X.509 certificates using NSS in the Chromium project.

methods.name: IsSameCertificate
methods.description: Checks if two certificate handles refer to the same certificate.

methods.name: CreateCERTCertificateFromBytes
methods.description: Creates a CERTCertificate handle from DER-encoded data.

methods.name: CreateCERTCertificateFromX509Certificate
methods.description: Creates a CERTCertificate handle from an X509Certificate object.

methods.name: CreateCERTCertificateListFromX509Certificate
methods.description: Creates a list of CERTCertificates from an X509Certificate and its intermediates.

methods.name: DupCERTCertificate
methods.description: Increments refcount and returns a handle for a CERTCertificate.

methods.name: DupCERTCertificateList
methods.description: Increments refcount for each element in a list of CERTCertificates.

methods.name: CreateX509CertificateFromCERTCertificate
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate from a CERTCertificate and optional chain.

methods.name: CreateX509CertificateListFromCERTCertificates
methods.description: Creates a list of X509Certificates from CERTCertificates.

methods.name: GetDEREncoded
methods.description: Retrieves DER-encoded data from a CERTCertificate.

methods.name: GetPEMEncoded
methods.description: Retrieves PEM-encoded data from a CERTCertificate.

methods.name: GetRFC822SubjectAltNames
methods.description: Extracts RFC822Name subjectAltNames from a certificate.

methods.name: GetUPNSubjectAltNames
methods.description: Extracts Microsoft UPN subjectAltNames from a certificate.

methods.name: GetDefaultUniqueNickname
methods.description: Generates a unique nickname for a certificate based on type and slot.

methods.name: GetCERTNameDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a display name for a certificate principal.

methods.name: GetValidityTimes
methods.description: Retrieves validity period times from a certificate.

methods.name: CalculateFingerprint256
methods.description: Calculates SHA-256 fingerprint of a certificate.

methods.name: ImportUserCert
methods.description: Imports a user certificate, requires private key to be installed.
